TAP flight fares

Not all trips are the same. Find out more about the different TAP fares and tailor each trip to your needs.

Choose how you want to travel

Whether you are looking for the lowest price, value maximum comfort or simply want the best solution for traveling with your family, we have the perfect alternative for you. Explore our fares and find the ideal one for your next trip:

  • Discount: a low price for those traveling with hand baggage only;
  • Basic: the best price with hold baggage included (available only on intercontinental flights);
  • Classic: hold baggage included and seat booking. The ideal option for families;
  • Plus: for those looking for total flexibility to change flights;
  • Prime: for those who want to travel with convenience and two hold baggages;
  • Top Prime: the benefits of Economy Prime, with total flexibility;
  • Executive: for those looking for the benefits and comfort of Business;
  • Top Executive: the benefits of Business, with total flexibility.

Find out more about all the benefits associated with the fare you have already purchased, or want to purchase, and add any extra services you want.
